Actual freshness depends on how often the BOE publishes a new version (batches). Cadence of election-night batches NOT verified - no archived snapshots found.
sources.granularity: County-wide totals per contest, plus precinct (election district, ED) level via per-ballot-item breakdown endpoint. 158 precincts/EDs, 69 polling places. Vote totals split by method: Election Day / Early Voting / Absentee-EMB / Affidavit. Precinct reporting status per ED and per group.
sources.verified_live: YES for HTTP 200 + JSON schema on GE2026 (pre-election placeholder with 101 ballot items, candidates, party colors, ED list, all zeros). YES for fully populated precinct-level results on prior election GE25 (final, asOf 2025-11-20; 1.26MB per-contest breakdown with 158 EDs x candidate x party-line x vote-method). Live election-night numbers: NOT yet observed.
sources.notes: UNDOCUMENTED but it is the first-party JSON backend of the official BOE-linked results page (BOE homepage button 'General Election 2026 Unofficial Election Results' links to https://app.enhancedvoting.com/results/public/dutchess-county-ny/GE2026). Not a published/supported API - may change or be rate-limited; poll politely (>=60s). ENDPOINTS (base https://app.enhancedvoting.com/results/public/api): GET /elections/{county-slug}/{electionId}/data = everything (jurisdiction, election meta, ballotItems[] with summaryResults.ballotOptions[] {name, party, voteCount, groupResults[]}, precincts[], pollingPlaces[], statistics, voterTurnout); GET /elections/{slug}/{id} = election metadata only (4KB; asOf/lastUpdated/publishDate/publishVersionId/isOfficialResults/ballotsCast/precinctsReporting) - cheap change-detection poll; GET /elections/{slug}/{id}/data/ballot-item/{ballotItemId} = single contest with breakdownResults[] per precinct (this is the ED-level data; ~1.2MB each); GET /elections/{slug}/{id}/closeraces; /stats; /turnout; /vr; /localities (these last 4 return empty on Dutchess); GET /jurisdictions/{slug} = jurisdiction info + list of all electionIds. Ballot item IDs come from /data. Fields: isWinner, isOfficialResults flags; party objects have hex colors. RACES ON DUTCHESS GE2026 BALLOT (101 items): Governor/Lt Gov (Hochul/Adams D+WFP vs Blakeman/Hood R+Con+VAP); State Comptroller (DiNapoli vs Hernandez); Attorney General (James vs Komatireddy); US House NY-17 (Cait Conley D vs Mike Lawler R); US House NY-18 (Pat Ryan D vs Jackie Auringer R); State Senate SD39 (Lisa Kaul D vs Robert Rolison R) and SD41 (Hinchey vs Sheehan); Assembly AD103 (Shrestha vs Lopez), AD104 (Jacobson, unopposed), AD105 (Talarico D vs Beephan R), AD106 (Didi Barrett D vs Gregory Campus R); County Sheriff (Imperati, unopposed R/Con); County Legislature districts 1-25; Supreme Court Justice; ~50 town/village/justice/library/highway/clerk/council races (Amenia, Beekman, Clinton, Dover, Hyde Park, Milan, Pawling, Pine Plains, Pleasant Valley, Poughkeepsie town+city library, Rhinebeck, Stanford, Union Vale, Wappinger wards, Washington, Millbrook, East Fishkill, LaGrange); ~10 town propositions. No US Senate race in NY in 2026 (not in feed). Contest 'voteFor' and 'referendum' fields present. DASHBOARD VIABILITY: high - clean JSON, stable IDs, precinct breakdown, vote-method split, party-line split (fusion lines listed separately: must sum Dem+Wor etc. per candidate by candidate name).

sources.name: Dutchess County BOE election results landing page + PDF/CSV archive
sources.latency: Static WordPress (WP Engine, nginx, cf-edge-cache, cache-control max-age=600) - the HTML page itself is cached 10 min. PDFs are posted after the fact; BOE states results are posted 'slowly throughout the evening and next day' (per local blog, no specific interval published). Absentee ballots are counted and uploaded later and totals shift.
sources.granularity: PDF reports per contest at county/ED level (e.g. 'Detailed Results by Contest Table' for PE26, GE25-Official-Summary-Results.pdf); older certified results include occasional CSV (e.g. .../wp-content/uploads/2020/02/GE13-Official-Results-Spreadsheet.csv).
sources.verified_live: YES - page returns 200 (verified headers). Homepage button to the Enhanced Voting GE2026 results confirmed in page HTML. No GE2026 election-night PDF/CSV exists yet.
sources.notes: Official sanctioned source but PDF-oriented; not good for live scraping. Also exposes WordPress REST at https://elections.dutchessny.gov/wp-json/ (wp/v2/pages, posts feed at /feed/) - useful only to detect when BOE posts a news item/new PDF (poll /wp-json/wp/v2/media or /feed/). Site is WP, NOT Clarity/Scytl, Civera, KnowInk or ElectionStats. The county main site www.dutchessny.gov/Departments/Board-of-Elections/ is legacy ASP.NET/IIS static HTML (no results API; /Election-Results.htm returns 302 -> 404).

summary:
Dutchess County BOE hosts election-night results on the Enhanced Voting platform, not on Clarity/Scytl, Civera, KnowInk or ElectionStats. The BOE homepage at elections.dutchessny.gov (WordPress on WP Engine) has a button 'General Election 2026 Unofficial Election Results' that links to https://app.enhancedvoting.com/results/public/dutchess-county-ny/GE2026. That page is an Angular app backed by an unauthenticated JSON API, which I found in the JS bundle and probed. It returns HTTP 200 with CORS '*', and responses are cached for 60 seconds (max-age=60). The API is undocumented and has no published terms.

To poll cheaply, GET /results/public/api/elections/dutchess-county-ny/GE2026 (4KB). It returns asOf, lastUpdated, publishDate, publishVersionId, ballotsCast and precinctsReporting, so a change in publishVersionId or asOf signals a new batch. Then GET .../GE2026/data (450KB) for all 101 contests with candidate, party-line and vote-method splits. Precinct-level (ED) results come from .../GE2026/data/ballot-item/{ballotItemId} (about 1.2MB per contest, 158 EDs). I confirmed this precinct-level schema on the finished GE25 election. Vote totals are split into Election Day, Early Voting, Absentee/EMB and Affidavit, and fusion party lines (Dem+WFP, Rep+Con) are separate rows that you have to sum per candidate.

As of 19:21 EST on Nov 3, the Dutchess GE2026 feed is a pre-election placeholder. asOf is Oct 27, ballotsCast is 0, every vote count is 0 and reporting units are 0/0. NY polls close at 9pm ET, so I could not observe live updates, and I could not verify the real election-night upload cadence. The BOE only says results post 'slowly throughout the evening and next day', and absentees are added later. Retry after about 9:15pm ET and watch the asOf and publishVersionId values to measure the batch cadence.

The Dutchess ballot has 101 items. State: Governor (Hochul/Adams vs Blakeman/Hood), Comptroller, Attorney General. Federal: NY-17 (Conley vs Lawler) and NY-18 (Ryan vs Auringer). Legislature: State Senate SD39 and SD41, and Assembly AD103 to AD106. County: Sheriff (Imperati, unopposed) and 25 County Legislature districts. Also a Supreme Court Justice contest, about 50 town, village and library races, and about 10 town propositions.

The same vendor backs the neighboring counties, so one adapter covers them. Probed with HTTP 200 on GE2026 /data: Orange (id GE2026, 340 precincts), Putnam (id GE2026_20261028103950, 81 precincts), Ulster (id GE2026_20261019155937, 165 precincts), Columbia (62), Rockland (307) and Westchester (id 2026GeneralElection, 906). All are pre-election zeros. Look up each county's election ID at /jurisdictions/{slug}, since the IDs differ, and judge existence by a non-empty .elections[] list, because junk slugs also return 200. Ulster's BOE site (elections.ulstercountyny.gov) is separate WordPress with static HTML/PDF results, and I could not confirm it links to Enhanced Voting. Orange's county site returned 403 to curl. The Dutchess county main site is a legacy ASP.NET static site with no results API.

The BOE's WordPress site also posts PDFs (and occasional CSV) of results, with the page cached for 10 minutes, and exposes /wp-json/ and /feed/. Those are useful only as a fallback or to detect new postings.

A dashboard is clearly feasible on this free source, as long as the BOE actually publishes during the night. Risks: the API is unofficial and could change or be throttled, and the update rate is bounded by BOE batch uploads. Poll the small metadata endpoint every 60 seconds and fetch /data only when publishVersionId changes. Nothing here required payment or authentication."}
